scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for every admissible parameter; a finite suite of numerical checks is supplementary, not an infinite certificate. Scientific review is self-review only, with no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: For Bessel order 1/2 and power-weight parameter 1 only, with exponential tilt strictly between zero and one; no claim for other orders or general monotone weights. The critical point is uniquely defined by a transcendental equation and cannot generally be expressed in elementary closed form. Unindexed equivalent special-function optimizations remain possible.
title: Unique sharp tilted endpoint constants for a half-integer Bessel moment
